newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Treasury's Rubin confident on balanced budget.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Treasury's Rubin confident on balanced budget.

text.p: U.S. Treasury Secretary Robert Rubin said he is confident a balanced budget will be reached, however, he noted the process won't be easy.

"What we all need to do is to sit down and find common ground that's consistent with the President's principles and the principles of the Democratic and Republican Congress, but it's not going to be easy to do," Rubin said.
"I believe that in the final analysis ... we will get it done."
Rubin spoke to reporters at an annual Savings Bonds kick-off luncheon here on Wednesday.
